# GitHub Markdown Cheatsheet

A quick reference for GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM).

## Keyboard Shortcuts

- Save document: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>S</kbd>
- Command Palette: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd>
- Toggle Terminal: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>`</kbd>

## Text Formatting

- Text styling: **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~.
- Inline marks: <mark>Highlighted text</mark>
- Abbreviation: <abbr title="HyperText Markup Language">HTML</abbr>
- Subscript and superscript: H<sub>2</sub>O and 10<sup>6</sup>.
